_: ANTIGRAVITY CLI (agy). Install as <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json for one project, or merge into ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json to cover every project (older builds: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/hooks.json - confirm with /hooks before relying on either). Hook sets are named objects with an `enabled` flag and one array per event; the matcher is a regex over the tool name, and '.*' covers the shell tool, file tools, MCP tools and anything a future build adds. Workspace-local hooks load only in a TRUSTED workspace - trust it first, then fire one deliberate blocked read and confirm the line lands in docs/provenance/hook-blocks.jsonl. An untrusted workspace fails open silently, which is the worst outcome for this layer. Note also that the Antigravity IDE has not reliably run CLI hooks: if you implement in the IDE rather than in agy, treat Tier 1 and the audit as your real enforcement.
